refuted.finding: The INSTALLED tab carries a full 1 px focusBorder box on all four sides (rows y 77 and y 111, x 6 to 145), where the artboard draws only the 1 px underline, so in a non-focus state the selected tab reads as a boxed control and focus sits on the tab rather than on a selected row.
refuted.reason: The 1 px box is visible, but it is the tab's focus ring: hard DS-FOCUS-1/tabs measures 'outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1 (target 1 solid #0078d4 offset -1)', DS-FOCUS-3 draws rings after a click in the main panel in both looks, and hard DS-COLOR-4/tabs measures the 1 px active underline.

refuted.finding: A second, unlabelled count pill with a red border ('1') sits beside the '15' badge in the INSTALLED tab; the artboard's tab has one count badge, workbench tabs do not stack two pills, and no visible word says what the 1 counts.
refuted.reason: The red-outlined '1' is visible but is the designed vulnerability count: the interaction model says the Installed tab also shows how many packages are vulnerable, the 2026-10-31 UX-P2.5 decision names it, hard DS-COPY-5 reads 'tabs 2: count badges 3', and the artboard's fixture simply has no vulnerable package.

refuted.finding: The row with the Vulnerable badge has a text block 2 px taller than its neighbours: the name ink starts 20 px below the row top and the version 42 px below it, against 21 and 41 px in the Polly row, because the 20 px badge enlarges line 1 beyond its 20 px box.
refuted.reason: Ink rows do differ by 1 px per line (name from 20, version from 42, against 21 and 41 in Polly), but this is not visible in the crop and sits inside DS-ROW-1's 1 px centre tolerance, with the hard line reading 'centre offsets 0 ×28; lines 2 ×14'.

refuted.finding: The Installed tab carries a 1 px blue focus ring around the whole tab, so focus sits on the tab rather than the selected row; the artboard's installed-tab has only the active underline, and its ring is on the selected row.
refuted.reason: The ring is drawn on the tab that holds focus, and DS-FOCUS-2 concerns a focused row while no row is focused here; hard DS-FOCUS-1/tabs measures 'outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1' on target, and DS-FOCUS-3 allows it after a click in the main panel.

refuted.finding: The Installed tab shows a second, red-outlined count badge "1" beside the "15" count; the artboard's installed-tab draws one count badge only, and no rule in the design system defines this extra badge.
refuted.reason: The claim that no rule defines the badge is false: the interaction model defines the Installed tab's vulnerability count, the 2026-10-31 UX-P2.5 decision names it, hard DS-COPY-5 reads 'tabs 2: count badges 3', and DS-HEIGHT-10 passes every count badge.

refuted.finding: The dependency framework rows are all semibold, the same weight as the 'Dependencies' header above them, so nine rows read as headings and not as workbench tree rows, which use regular weight.
refuted.reason: The rows are semibold in the crop, but hard DS-TYPE-5 measures 'level ×9: 13px/600/none ×9 (target 13px/600/none)', so the weight is the measured target.

refuted.finding: The dependency group rows show counts as '(0)' and '(4)' text, while this surface's tab and group headers use count badges, giving two count styles on one surface.
refuted.reason: The '(0)' and '(4)' texts are visible, but hard DS-COPY-5 reads 'headers 1: count badges 1, "(N)" texts 0', and its check is that no header shows both a badge and '(N)'; these rows show no badge beside the text.

refuted.finding: The first content line under the Details/README strip starts close to the strip's line: the strip ends at y 218 and the description's ink starts at y 229-230, about 8 px of padding where the spec's readme-content pane declares 20 px on all sides, so the block looks squeezed against the artboard.
refuted.reason: Description ink starts at y 229 under the strip, but the spec's 20 px padding belongs to readme-content on the README tab; the artboard does not draw this Details tab and DS-INSET-4 binds only the header, so no rule or redline sets this gap.

refuted.finding: Content under the two details group headers uses two different indents from the 440 inset: the Vulnerabilities row's glyph starts at x 457 and its text near x 476, while the Dependencies rows' chevron starts at x 450 and their text at x 465.
refuted.reason: The indents differ in the crop (glyph x 457, text x 477; chevron x 450, text x 465), but the spec and artboard draw neither row and DS-INSET-1 does not list these elements, so nothing cited binds them (rubric §6).

findings.finding: [native] The trailing edges of the list column do not coincide: the Uninstall button ends at x 403 and the Direct Packages count badge at x 395, 8 px apart, where the artboard ends both at x 311. | [geometry] The Direct Packages count badge ends at x 396 while the toolbar's Uninstall Selected button above it ends at x 404, an 8 px miss caused by the list scrollbar; the artboard has both ending at x 311 and T-5 says the toolbar end edge aligns with the group headers' trailing badges.
findings.ruling: DS-INSET-3 (c) is per container and both insets hold (toolbar 16 inside the pane: PF-4 button 404 = inset line 404; badge 16 inside the group box: group headers 16); the 8 px between them is DS-SCROLL-1's space-taking scrollbar (M 8, probed as offsetWidth − clientWidth, P0.22), which narrows the tree's client area and every row and in-list header with it. The workbench's edges coincide because its list draws its slider over the rows (ext_rows[0] right 343 = pane_headers[0] right 343), a mechanism Chromium 122 has no CSS for (overflow: overlay is auto); the scrollbar mechanism is P3.9's (DS-SCROLL-1), noted there.
